claims.sentence: Huntsman spiders belong to the family Sparassidae.
They inject venom into their prey, usually insects and small arthropods, to paralyse them before eating.
However, their venom is not a health threat to humans.
It is designed to work on small invertebrates, not on mammals our size.
Bites to humans are extremely rare.
Even if bitten, the venom would cause at most minor local effects like slight swelling or irritation.
Most huntsman spiders in Perth are brown or tan.
No. Huntsman venom is not lethal to humans.
No deaths or serious poisonings from huntsman bites are recorded in Australia.
Most huntsman species live for around one to two years as adults.
Huntsman spider management typically costs 220 to 300 dollars for a standard three-bedroom home in Perth's northern suburbs, GST inclusive.
General pest management, which can include spider harbouring areas, ranges from 250 to 350 dollars.
Work is carried out by, or under the direct supervision of, a technician holding a WA pest management technician's licence.
